test_cases.title: Diabetes - Trushna and Aruchi Treatment Protocol
test_cases.question: A patient with diabetes mellitus presents with Trushna (polydipsia) and Aruchi (impaired taste). According to the guideline, what are the prescribed medicines, Matra, Sahpaan, and Aushadh Kal?
test_cases.section: All mentioned guidelines below maybe considered based on onset or chronicity and severity of symptoms.
test_cases.verification_notes: Chunk contains exact clinical table for Trushna (Polydipsia) and Aruchi with Zincare 2-0-2 and Kansya Rasayan 0-0-1.

test_cases.title: Diabetes - Primary Prevention for Overweight and Family History
test_cases.question: What are the primary prevention guidelines and recommended Rasayana medications for high-risk individuals with family history of diabetes mellitus or overweight (BMI >= 25)?
test_cases.section: PRIMARY PREVENTION HELPFUL GUIDELINES (HELP TO PREVENT ONSET OF DIABETES IN IMPAIRED GLUCOSE TOLERANCE AND IMPAIRED FASTING GLYCAEMIA/PRE-DIABETES, FAMILY HISTORY OF DM/RISKY PATIENTS)
test_cases.verification_notes: Chunk specifies prophylactic treatment for At-Risk BMI >= 25 (Obecon 2-2-2) and Family History of DM (Sannidha Rasayan 2-0-2).
